model: P / G / R / TMC precision air conditioners with SURVEY3 controller (software 3.0)
applies_to: Aermec P, G, R and TMC close control air conditioners for data and technical rooms with the SURVEY3 controller, software version 3.0, fitted with the BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP option.
summary: The SURVEY3 controller runs Aermec precision air conditioners (DX, chilled water, two-source and free cooling variants). Its supervisor table maps each value to a Modbus register and a BACnet object: 530 objects covering digital inputs and alarms, outputs, return/supply temperature and humidity, remote probe modules, compressor and EEV data, fans, water circuit, humidifier, working hours, setpoints and regulation parameters, and alarm resets.
notes: Most objects only apply to some unit types and options (compressor 2, free cooling, two sources, humidifier, fans 2-10, remote probe modules).

The table prints AV 12 twice (FanSpeed and fan1Actspeed) and BI 91 twice (Fan7CommAl and CPYHighWatConductAl); AV 23 and BI 191 are absent, so the second rows are probably meant to be AV 23 and BI 191. Both rows are kept as printed.
Access is from the table's Mode column (R or R/W). Multistate value state texts are footnotes in the manual and are not repeated here.
32-bit values (counters, energy, flow) are single AV objects in BACnet; only Modbus splits them into Low/High registers.
Source: user manual 20.11 - 5895970_01 (EN), section 10.3, pages 146-172 (530 objects).

source.title: Precision air conditioners P-G-R-TMC user manual

integration.summary: Fit the BACnet MS/TP (RS485) or BACnet IP (RJ45) option and set Device ID, baud rate, max master and MAC ID in User set-up > BACnet. Switch the unit with SupervOFF (BV 1), write temperature and humidity setpoints, and read unit status, temperatures, humidity, outputs and alarms.
integration.enable: On/Off from supervisor is BV 1 (SupervOFF), writable.
setup: Software version B offers BACnet IP on the RJ45 port; version C offers BACnet MS/TP on RS485.
BACnet menu defaults: Device ID 127 (range 1-4194303), baud 76800 (9600/19200/38400/76800), Max Master 127, MAC ID 1. Section 10.2.1 lists 57600 as the MS/TP default instead.
Communication parameter changes need a controller reboot.
gotchas: Regulation parameters (bands, times, offsets) are setup values; don't write them cyclically.
Alarm reset BVs reset latched alarms; write them only when needed.
